mainTopic: Doubtful eating of חלב mixed with other pieces, sharing offerings, the פרוטה value of נותר, and איסור חל על איסור in קדשים
overview: The משנה lays out cases of two pieces where one is definitely חלב and the other is ordinary meat (חולין), sacrificial meat (קודש), sacrificial חלב, or חלב that is also נותר. For each pair it rules on one person who ate one piece without knowing which, or ate both. It also rules on two people who each ate one piece. רבי עקיבא gives each person an אשם תלוי, רבי שמעון lets the two share one offering for the doubt, and רבי יוסי says two people cannot share an offering. The גמרא begins with רבא asking רב נחמן what רבי יוסי adds. The answer is that the anonymous תנא קמא is רבי יוסי himself. Next רבא asks why eating נותר does not also bring an אשם ודאי for מעילה. רב נחמן answers that the piece is worth less than a פרוטה, because it is small or because it spoiled in the summer heat. Finally רבא asks how רבי שמעון lets the איסור of נותר take effect on a piece that is already forbidden. After rejecting a few answers, the גמרא concludes that for קדשים the תורה revealed that one איסור can take effect on another.

steps.title: Two people cannot share one guilt offering
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוסי's closing line in an earlier dispute: two people do not bring a single אשם together.
steps.simpleTranslation: Two people do not bring one guilt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: This line finishes a dispute that began just before this section. רבי יוסי rules that two people cannot join together to bring one אשם.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each person needs his own offering for his own possible sin. Two people cannot split one קרבן and say it should count for whichever of them actually sinned. This same idea of רבי יוסי will come back in each of the cases that follow.

keyTerms.meaning: Guilt offering
Two people
One (a single offering)

phrases.english: Two people do not bring one guilt offering.
phrases.notes: This is רבי יוסי finishing a dispute from the case right before this one.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֵין שְׁנַיִם מְבִיאִין אָשָׁם אֶחָד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the previous case of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Two people cannot share one אשם.

steps.title: Forbidden fat and plain meat: one person eats one or both
steps.stepSummary: One piece is חלב and one is חולין. Eating one unknown piece requires an אשם תלוי. Eating both requires a חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of ordinary meat. If someone ate one of them and does not know which, he brings a provisional guilt offering. If he then ate the second piece too, he brings a sin offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה starts a new case with two pieces: one forbidden fat (חלב) and one ordinary meat (חולין). It rules on one person who ate one piece, or both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Eating only one piece leaves a doubt: maybe it was the חלב. A doubt like this calls for an אשם תלוי. Once he eats the second piece too, he has definitely eaten the חלב, so he brings a regular חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: Forbidden fat
Ordinary, non-sacred food
Provisional guilt offering, brought when one is unsure if he sinned
Sin offering, brought for a definite accidental sin

phrases.english: A piece of forbidden fat and a piece of ordinary meat,
he ate one of them
and does not know which of them he ate –
he brings a provisional guilt offering.
If he ate the second one –
he brings a sin offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת חוּלִּין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new case in the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A doubt about eating חלב requires an אשם תלוי. Definitely eating חלב requires a חטאת.
steps.whyThisMatters: This is the basic model. The next two cases change what the second piece is.

steps.title: Two people each eat one piece: each brings a provisional offering
steps.stepSummary: רבי עקיבא: if two different people each ate one piece, each one brings his own אשם תלוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one person ate the first piece and another person came and ate the second piece, each of them brings a provisional guilt offering. This is the view of רבי עקיבא.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה changes the case: now two different people each ate one of the pieces. רבי עקיבא rules that each one brings an אשם תלוי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: One of the two certainly ate חלב, but neither one personally knows that he did. So from each person's own point of view it is only a doubt, and each brings an אשם תלוי. Neither one brings a חטאת.

keyTerms.meaning: The first piece
The second piece
Another person

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix this up with step 2. There, the same person ate both pieces and is certain he ate חלב. Here it is two different people, so each one is only in doubt.

phrases.english: If one person ate the first one
and another came and ate the second one –
this one brings a provisional guilt offering
and that one brings a provisional guilt offering,
these are the words of Rabbi Akiva.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָכַל אֶחָד אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה וּבָא אַחֵר וְאָכַל אֶת הַשְּׁנִיָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same two pieces, but now split between two people.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each person brings his own אשם תלוי.

steps.title: רבי שמעון and רבי יוסי on sharing one sin offering
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון: the two people bring one חטאת together. רבי יוסי: two people cannot bring one חטאת.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: both of them bring one sin offering together. רבי יוסי says: two people do not bring one sin offering.
steps.whatsHappening: Two more opinions are given on the case of two people. רבי שמעון lets them share one חטאת, and רבי יוסי does not allow it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון reasons that one of them definitely ate חלב. So they can bring one חטאת together, meant for whichever one actually sinned. רבי יוסי holds that a קרבן cannot be shared this way, the same rule he gave for an אשם in step 1.

keyTerms.meaning: Both of them (together)
One single sin offering

steps.whatToRemember: There are three views on two people: רבי עקיבא says each brings an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says they share one חטאת. רבי יוסי says sharing is not allowed.

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says:
Both of them bring one sin offering.
Rabbi Yosei says:
Two people do not bring one sin offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: שְׁנֵיהֶם מְבִיאִין חַטָּאת אַחַת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives views that disagree with רבי עקיבא in the same case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי שמעון: share one חטאת. רבי יוסי: no sharing.

steps.title: Forbidden fat and sacrificial meat: one person eats one or both
steps.stepSummary: One piece is חלב and one is קודש. Eating one unknown piece requires an אשם תלוי. Eating both requires a חטאת and an אשם ודאי.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial meat. If someone ate one and does not know which, he brings a provisional guilt offering. If he then ate the second piece too, he brings a sin offering and a definite guilt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה brings a second case. Now the other piece is sacrificial (קודש) instead of ordinary, and it rules on one person who ate one piece or both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With one piece eaten, he might have eaten the חלב, so he brings an אשם תלוי. After eating both, he surely ate the חלב, which requires a חטאת. He also surely ate the sacrificial piece, which is misusing holy property and requires an אשם ודאי.

keyTerms.meaning: Sacrificial, consecrated food
A definite guilt offering, here for misusing holy property

phrases.english: A piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial meat,
he ate one of them
and does not know which of them he ate –
he brings a provisional guilt offering.
If he ate the second one –
he brings a sin offering and a definite guilt offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת קוֹדֶשׁ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same pattern as step 2, but the second piece is now קודש.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Eating both pieces requires a חטאת for the חלב and an אשם ודאי for the sacrificial piece.

steps.title: Two people eat the fat and the sacrificial meat
steps.stepSummary: When two people each ate one piece, each brings an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says they share a חטאת and an אשם. רבי יוסי says they cannot share.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one person ate the first piece and another ate the second, each brings a provisional guilt offering. רבי שמעון says both of them bring a sin offering and a guilt offering together. רבי יוסי says two people do not bring one sin offering and one guilt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה applies the two-people question to the case of חלב and קודש. It repeats the same three-way pattern from steps 3 and 4.
steps.deeperAnalysis: One of the two definitely ate חלב, and the other definitely ate the sacrificial piece. רבי שמעון therefore has them jointly bring a חטאת and an אשם, each counting for whoever owes it. רבי יוסי again forbids sharing, so each person only brings an אשם תלוי for his own doubt.

keyTerms.meaning: A sin offering and a guilt offering
Both of them

phrases.english: If one person ate the first one
and another came and ate the second one –
this one brings a provisional guilt offering
and that one brings a provisional guilt offering.
Rabbi Shimon says:
Both of them bring a sin offering and a guilt offering.
phrases.notes: The חטאת is for whoever ate the חלב, and the אשם is for whoever ate the sacrificial piece.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei says:

phrases.aramaic: אֵין שְׁנַיִם מְבִיאִין חַטָּאת וְאָשָׁם אֶחָד.
phrases.english: Two people do not bring one sin offering and one guilt offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָכַל אֶחָד אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה וּבָא אַחֵר וְאָכַל אֶת הַשְּׁנִיָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the two-people dispute to the חלב and קודש case.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each person brings an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון: they share a חטאת and an אשם. רבי יוסי: no sharing.

steps.title: Forbidden fat and sacrificial forbidden fat
steps.stepSummary: Both pieces are חלב, and one is also sacrificial. Eating one requires a חטאת, and רבי עקיבא adds an אשם תלוי. Eating both requires two חטאות and an אשם ודאי.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial forbidden fat. If someone ate one and does not know which, he brings a sin offering. רבי עקיבא says: also a provisional guilt offering. If he then ate the second piece, he brings two sin offerings and a definite guilt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives a third case: both pieces are חלב, but one of them is also sacrificial. It rules on eating one piece and on eating both.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Either way he ate חלב, so even with one piece he certainly owes a חטאת. רבי עקיבא adds an אשם תלוי because maybe he ate the sacrificial piece, which would be misusing holy property. After eating both, he ate חלב twice and so brings two חטאות, plus an אשם ודאי for surely eating the sacrificial piece.

keyTerms.meaning: Forbidden fat that is also sacrificial
Two sin offerings
Also, in addition

steps.confusionAlert: Here one piece is enough to need a חטאת, unlike the first two cases. That is because both pieces are חלב, so there is no doubt that he ate חלב.

phrases.english: A piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial forbidden fat,
he ate one of them
and does not know which of them he ate –
he brings a sin offering,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: אַף אָשָׁם תָּלוּי.
phrases.english: Rabbi Akiva says: also a provisional guilt offering.
phrases.notes: The extra offering is for the doubt that maybe he ate the sacrificial piece.

phrases.english: If he ate the second one –
he brings two sin offerings and a definite guilt offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב קוֹדֶשׁ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third case, where both pieces are חלב.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Eating one piece requires a חטאת, and רבי עקיבא adds an אשם תלוי. Eating both requires two חטאות and an אשם ודאי.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows רבי עקיבא's view that a doubt about misusing holy property also calls for an אשם תלוי.

steps.title: Two people each ate one piece of plain fat and sacrificial fat
steps.stepSummary: This is the two-person version of the case of חלב and חלב קודש. Each person brings a חטאת. רבי עקיבא adds an אשם תלוי for each. רבי שמעון says they share one אשם. רבי יוסי says they cannot share.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one person ate the first piece and another person ate the second, each brings a חטאת. רבי עקיבא says each also brings an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says each brings a חטאת, and together they bring one אשם. רבי יוסי says the two of them cannot bring one אשם together.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה goes back to the case from step 7, where both pieces are חלב and one is also sacrificial, and now asks what happens when two different people each ate one piece.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both pieces are חלב, so each person surely ate חלב and owes a חטאת. The doubt is only about who ate the sacrificial piece. That doubt is what רבי עקיבא, רבי שמעון and רבי יוסי argue about. It is the same argument as in steps 3-6, now applied to this case.

keyTerms.meaning: This one and that one: each of the two people
One guilt offering brought by two people as partners

phrases.english: If one person ate the first piece
and another person came and ate the second piece,
phrases.notes: We are still in the case from step 7: two pieces of חלב, and one of them is also sacrificial.

phrases.aramaic: זֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת וְזֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת.
phrases.english: this one brings a sin offering and that one brings a sin offering.
Rabbi Akiva says:
this one and that one each bring a provisional guilt offering.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: זֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת וְזֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת,
phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says: this one brings a sin offering and that one brings a sin offering,
and the two of them bring one guilt offering together.
phrases.notes: They share it as partners, so it counts for whichever one really ate the sacrificial piece.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: אֵין שְׁנֵיהֶן מְבִיאִין אָשָׁם אֶחָד.
phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei says: the two of them do not bring one guilt offering.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָכַל אֶחָד אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה וּבָא אַחֵר וְאָכַל אֶת הַשְּׁנִיָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the case from step 7 by adding the two-person version.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each eater brings a חטאת for the sure חלב. On the doubtful sacrificial piece: רבי עקיבא says each brings an אשם תלוי, רבי שמעון says they share one אשם, and רבי יוסי says they cannot share.

steps.title: One person ate from plain fat and fat that is also leftover sacrificial meat
steps.stepSummary: There are two pieces of חלב, and one is also נותר. If one person ate one piece and does not know which, he brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. If he ate both, he brings three חטאות.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a piece of חלב and a piece of חלב that is also נותר. If someone ate one of them and does not know which, he brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. If he then ate the second piece, he brings three חטאות.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה starts a new pair of pieces. One is plain חלב, and the other is חלב that is also נותר, which is a second sin that carries a חטאת.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Whichever piece he ate, it was חלב, so a חטאת is certain. The only doubt is whether he also ate נותר, and that doubt gets an אשם תלוי. If he ate both, every sin is certain: two חטאות for the two pieces of חלב, and a third for the נותר.

keyTerms.meaning: Sacrificial meat left over past its allowed time; eating it by mistake requires a חטאת
A provisional guilt offering, brought when one is unsure whether he did a sin that needs a חטאת
Three sin offerings: two for חלב and one for נותר

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix this up with step 7. There, the extra sin was misuse of holy property, which needs an אשם ודאי. Here, the extra sin is נותר, which needs a חטאת. That is why eating both pieces here means three חטאות, not two חטאות and an אשם.

phrases.english: A piece of forbidden fat and a piece of forbidden fat that is leftover sacrificial meat,
if he ate one of them
and does not know which of them he ate,
he brings a sin offering and a provisional guilt offering.

phrases.aramaic: אָכַל אֶת הַשְּׁנִיָּה – מֵבִיא שָׁלֹשׁ חַטָּאוֹת.
phrases.english: If he ate the second, he brings three sin offerings.

steps.triggerLanguage: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב נוֹתָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Introduces a new pair of pieces, where the extra sin is נותר (a חטאת sin) instead of misuse of holy property.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Eating one unknown piece requires a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. Eating both requires three חטאות.

steps.title: Two people each ate one piece of plain fat and leftover fat
steps.stepSummary: In the נותר case with two people, each brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says each brings a חטאת and together they bring one more חטאת. רבי יוסי says two people can never bring a חטאת that atones for a sin.
steps.simpleTranslation: If one person ate the first piece and another ate the second, each brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says each brings a חטאת, and the two together bring one more חטאת. רבי יוסי says any חטאת that comes for a sin cannot be brought by two people.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the two-person version of the נותר case, and רבי שמעון and רבי יוסי argue again about sharing the doubtful offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each person surely ate חלב, so each owes a חטאת. One of them surely ate נותר, but nobody knows which one. The תנא קמא gives each an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says they can share one real חטאת as partners. רבי יוסי rejects this with a general rule: a חטאת for a sin must belong to the one sinner.

keyTerms.meaning: One sin offering brought by two people as partners
A sin offering that comes to atone for a specific sin
Two people (as partners in one offering)

steps.whatToRemember: In all the two-person cases, רבי שמעון lets the two people share one offering for the doubt, and רבי יוסי says they cannot. Here רבי יוסי gives his reason as a general rule about any חטאת that comes for a sin.

phrases.english: If one person ate the first piece
and another person came and ate the second piece,
this one brings a sin offering and a provisional guilt offering,
and that one brings a sin offering and a provisional guilt offering.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: זֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת וְזֶה מֵבִיא חַטָּאת,
phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says: this one brings a sin offering and that one brings a sin offering,
and the two of them bring one sin offering together.
phrases.notes: This shared חטאת is for the נותר, and it counts for whichever of them really ate it.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yosei says:

phrases.aramaic: כׇּל חַטָּאת שֶׁהִיא בָּאָה עַל חֵטְא –
phrases.english: any sin offering that comes for a sin,
two people do not bring it.

steps.triggerLanguage: כׇּל חַטָּאת שֶׁהִיא בָּאָה עַל חֵטְא אֵין שְׁנַיִם מְבִיאִין אוֹתָהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the two-person version of the נותר case from step 9.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Each eater brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי. רבי שמעון says each brings a חטאת and together they share one more חטאת. רבי יוסי says two people can never share a חטאת that comes for a sin.
steps.whyThisMatters: רבי יוסי's general rule about a חטאת that comes for a sin is what the גמרא is about to examine.

steps.title: רבא asks whether רבי יוסי says anything new
steps.stepSummary: רבא asks רב נחמן: if רבי יוסי only rules out sharing a חטאת, then each person still brings an אשם תלוי. But that is exactly what the תנא קמא said, so what is רבי יוסי adding?
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said to רב נחמן: According to רבי יוסי, it is a חטאת that the two cannot bring together, but an אשם תלוי they each do bring? That is the same as the תנא קמא!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins. רבא challenges רבי יוסי's opinion in the first case of the משנה, because it seems to say nothing different from the תנא קמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first case (חלב and חולין, steps 3-4), the תנא קמא said each person brings an אשם תלוי. רבי יוסי only said two cannot bring one חטאת, so he seems to agree that each brings an אשם תלוי. If so, his view is identical to the תנא קמא, and a separate opinion would have no point.

keyTerms.meaning: The Talmud's discussion of the משנה
The first, unnamed opinion in the משנה
That is the same as
They bring

phrases.english: GEMARA
Rava said to Rav Nachman:

phrases.aramaic: לְרַבִּי יוֹסֵי, חַטָּאת הוּא דְּלָא מַיְיתוּ שְׁנֵיהֶן,
phrases.english: According to Rabbi Yosei, it is a sin offering that the two of them do not bring together,
phrases.notes: רבא is talking about the first case of the משנה, the חלב and the plain meat, from step 4.

phrases.english: but a provisional guilt offering, both of them do bring?
That is the same as the first tanna!

steps.triggerLanguage: הַיְינוּ תַּנָּא קַמָּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the גמרא with a challenge to רבי יוסי's opinion in the משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוסי's statement that two people cannot bring one חטאת, in the case of חלב and חולין.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If רבי יוסי only rules out sharing a חטאת, he agrees that each person brings an אשם תלוי. That is exactly the תנא קמא's ruling, so his opinion seems to add nothing.

steps.title: Blocking a possible answer about one piece out of two
steps.stepSummary: רבא heads off a possible answer: maybe רבי יוסי argues about the second person, who ate when only one piece was left. A ברייתא shows רבי יוסי makes both people bring an אשם תלוי, so that cannot be the difference.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you would say the difference between them is the case of one piece from two pieces, isn't it taught in a ברייתא: רבי יוסי says this one brings an אשם תלוי and that one brings an אשם תלוי!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא is still pressing his question from step 11. He suggests one possible answer and knocks it down right away with a ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Someone might say רבי יוסי and the תנא קמא disagree about the second eater, who had only one piece in front of him. Then that person would owe no אשם תלוי according to רבי יוסי. But the ברייתא says clearly that, according to רבי יוסי, both people bring an אשם תלוי, so the question 'what is רבי יוסי adding?' still stands.

keyTerms.meaning: One piece out of two pieces: a doubt that arises only because two pieces were in front of the person
There is a difference between them
And if you would say: introduces a possible answer so it can be rejected

phrases.english: And if you would say:
one piece from two pieces
phrases.notes: This is the second person, who ate when only one piece was left. He never had two pieces in front of him.

phrases.english: is the difference between them,
but isn't it taught: Rabbi Yosei says:
this one brings a provisional guilt offering
and that one brings a provisional guilt offering!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵימָא: חֲתִיכָה מִשְׁתֵּי חֲתִיכוֹת אִיכָּא בֵּינַיְיהוּ, וְהָתַנְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Strengthens the קשיא of step 11 by closing off a possible answer.
steps.kashyaTarget: A possible answer that רבי יוסי exempts the second eater from an אשם תלוי
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא says that according to רבי יוסי both people bring an אשם תלוי, so he cannot be exempting the second one.

steps.title: The anonymous opinion belongs to רבי יוסי
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן answers that רבי יוסי is not adding a new law. His statement shows us that the anonymous תנא קמא is רבי יוסי himself.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: This is what it teaches us, that who is the תנא קמא? רבי יוסי.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן answers רבא's question. רבי יוסי's statement is not a disagreement. It tells us who the author of the anonymous opinion is.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא asked why רבי יוסי repeats what the תנא קמא already said. רב נחמן agrees that both say the same thing about the אשם תלוי. The point is to show that the first, anonymous ruling is really רבי יוסי's view.

keyTerms.meaning: The first, anonymous opinion in a משנה or ברייתא
This is what it comes to teach us

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוסי agrees that each person brings an אשם תלוי. His statement reveals that the anonymous תנא קמא is רבי יוסי.

phrases.english: He said to him:
phrases.notes: רב נחמן is answering רבא.

phrases.english: this is what it teaches us,
that who is the first tanna? Rabbi Yosei.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הָא קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן, דְּמַאן תַּנָּא קַמָּא – רַבִּי יוֹסֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of steps 11 and 12.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Identifying who wrote the anonymous opinion
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי יוסי must be adding a new law beyond the תנא קמא.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי יוסי adds no new law. He shows that the תנא קמא is his own opinion.

steps.title: Why no אשם ודאי for the נותר piece?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's cases, ending with חלב and חלב נותר. רבא asks why the person does not also bring an אשם ודאי, since נותר comes from קדשים.
steps.simpleTranslation: A piece of חלב and a piece of קודש; a piece of חלב and a piece of חלב קודש, etc.; a piece of חלב and a piece of חלב נותר, etc. רבא said to רב נחמן: Let him also bring an אשם ודאי, since נותר is קודש!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה again to start a new discussion. Then רבא challenges the ruling of three חטאות in the נותר case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the משנה's case of חלב and קודש, eating the קודש piece brings an אשם ודאי for מעילה. נותר is leftover meat from a קרבן, so it is also קודש. רבא asks why the משנה lists only three חטאות and no אשם ודאי.

keyTerms.meaning: Meat of a קרבן left past the time when it may be eaten
A definite guilt offering, brought here for מעילה (misusing holy property)
Holy, consecrated food from קדשים
Etc.: the rest of the quoted משנה is left out

phrases.english: A piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial food,

phrases.aramaic: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב קוֹדֶשׁ כּוּ׳
phrases.english: a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of sacrificial forbidden fat, etc.,

phrases.aramaic: חֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב וַחֲתִיכַת חֵלֶב נוֹתָר כּוּ׳.
phrases.english: a piece of forbidden fat and a piece of forbidden fat that is notar, etc.
phrases.notes: This is the case from step 9, where eating both pieces brings three חטאות.

phrases.english: Rava said to Rav Naḥman:
And let him also bring a definite guilt offering,
since notar is sacrificial food!

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא לְרַב נַחְמָן: וְלַיְתֵי נָמֵי אָשָׁם וַדַּאי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new discussion on a different line of the משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: The ruling of three חטאות in the חלב נותר case
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: נותר is קודש, so eating it should also bring an אשם ודאי for מעילה.

steps.title: The נותר piece is worth less than a פרוטה
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן answers that the case is where the piece is not worth a שוה פרוטה, so there is no אשם ודאי.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: It is where it is not worth a פרוטה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן explains why the משנה leaves out the אשם ודאי. The piece is too cheap to count for that offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An אשם ודאי for misusing holy property is brought only when the item is worth at least a פרוטה. If the נותר piece is worth less, there are only the three חטאות.

keyTerms.meaning: Worth a פרוטה, the smallest coin value that counts in הלכה
It does not have in it

phrases.aramaic: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: דְּלֵית בֵּיהּ שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה.
phrases.english: He said to him: where it does not have the value of a peruta.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: דְּלֵית בֵּיהּ שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבא's קשיא by narrowing the case.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Eating נותר should always add an אשם ודאי.
steps.terutzMaskana: Here the piece is worth less than a פרוטה, so no אשם ודאי is owed.

steps.title: The משנה's first case is worth a פרוטה
steps.stepSummary: רבא objects: at the start of the משנה we are clearly dealing with pieces worth a פרוטה, since it rules there is an אשם ודאי.
steps.simpleTranslation: But from the start we are dealing with something worth a פרוטה, since it teaches an אשם ודאי!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא challenges רב נחמן's answer. The משנה's earlier case shows that its pieces are worth a פרוטה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the case of חלב and קודש, the משנה requires an אשם ודאי, so those pieces must be worth a פרוטה. Why would the later נותר case suddenly be about a smaller piece?

keyTerms.meaning: From the start, at the beginning
We are dealing with

phrases.english: But at the outset
phrases.notes: He means the earlier case in the משנה of a piece of חלב and a piece of קודש, where eating both brings an אשם ודאי.

phrases.english: we are dealing with one that has the value of a peruta,
since it teaches a definite guilt offering!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא מֵעִיקָּרָא דְּאִית בֵּיהּ שָׁוֶה פְּרוּטָה עָסְקִינַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer given in step 15.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב נחמן's claim that the piece is worth less than a פרוטה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה's earlier ruling of an אשם ודאי shows that its pieces are worth a פרוטה.

steps.title: Only the non-נותר piece is worth a פרוטה
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן answers that the earlier piece was not נותר, so it was worth a פרוטה. The נותר piece is a different case.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: That piece, which is not נותר, is worth a פרוטה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן defends his answer. He separates the earlier case from the נותר case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier piece of קודש was not נותר, so it had the value of a פרוטה. The answer suggests that a piece which became נותר can be worth less, so the two cases need not match.

keyTerms.meaning: That one
Is worth

phrases.english: He said to him:
that piece is one that is not notar,
and it is worth a peruta.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הָהִיא חֲתִיכָה דְּלָא נוֹתָר הִיא שָׁוְיָא פְּרוּטָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 16.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: All the pieces in the משנה have the same value.
steps.terutzMaskana: The non-נותר piece is worth a פרוטה. The נותר piece need not be.

steps.title: The משנה of one eating that is five sins
steps.stepSummary: רבא cites the משנה about one act of eating that is several sins. That case involves נותר and rules four חטאות and one אשם, so נותר can be worth a פרוטה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is the משנה 'there is one who eats one eating,' which teaches נותר, and teaches that he brings four חטאות and one אשם!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא brings another משנה against רב נחמן's answer. The answer comes in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: That משנה lists an אשם along with four חטאות for one act of eating נותר. That means the נותר there was worth a פרוטה, which challenges the idea that נותר is worth less.

keyTerms.meaning: There is one who eats one eating: a משנה about a single act of eating that breaks several prohibitions
Four sin offerings

steps.confusionAlert: The אשם in that משנה is for מעילה, which only applies to something worth a פרוטה. That is why it challenges רב נחמן.

phrases.english: But there is the case of one who eats one eating
phrases.notes: This is the משנה on 13b about a single act of eating that counts as several sins.

phrases.english: in which it teaches notar,
and it teaches: he brings four sin offerings
and one guilt offering!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא יֵשׁ אוֹכֵל אֲכִילָה אַחַת דְּקָתָנֵי בֵּיהּ נוֹתָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge to רב נחמן's distinction in step 17.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that the נותר piece is worth less than a פרוטה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Another משנה requires an אשם for eating נותר, so נותר there is worth a פרוטה.

steps.title: Big piece versus small piece
steps.stepSummary: רב נחמן answers that the other משנה is talking about a large piece of נותר, and our משנה is talking about a small piece.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: That משנה is talking about a large piece, and this one is talking about a small piece.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן answers רבא's question from Step 18. The משנה that gives an אשם for נותר is about a big piece worth a פרוטה. Our משנה is about a small piece that is not worth a פרוטה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא proved from the other משנה that נותר can be worth a פרוטה. רב נחמן agrees, but says it depends on the size of the piece. A big piece of נותר is worth a פרוטה and brings an אשם, while a small piece is not worth a פרוטה and brings no אשם.

keyTerms.meaning: Large, a big piece (excessive eating)
Small, a thin or little piece

phrases.english: He said to him: That one is about a large piece,
phrases.notes: "That one" is the משנה רבא just quoted, where eating נותר brings an אשם.

phrases.english: and this one is about a small piece.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הָהִיא – בְּגַסָּה, וְהַהִיא – בְּדַקָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבא's challenge from Step 18 by splitting the two משניות into different cases.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Splitting the cases (אוקימתא): different sizes of the piece
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The נותר in both משניות is the same kind of piece. Since it is worth a פרוטה in the other משנה, it should be worth a פרוטה in ours too.
steps.terutzMaskana: A big piece of נותר is worth a פרוטה. A small piece is not.

steps.title: Rainy season versus summer
steps.stepSummary: A second answer: the other משנה is about נותר in the rainy season, when meat stays fresh and is worth a פרוטה. Our משנה is about the summer, when it spoils.
steps.simpleTranslation: Or, it is not difficult: that משנה is about the rainy season, and here it is about the hot season.
steps.whatsHappening: רב נחמן gives a second way to answer the same question. This time the difference is the time of year, not the size of the piece.
steps.deeperAnalysis: נותר is meat left past its time. In the cold rainy season it does not spoil quickly, so it can still be worth a פרוטה and bring an אשם. In the summer it spoils fast and loses its value, so there is no אשם.

keyTerms.meaning: And it is not difficult. Here it introduces another answer.
The rainy season (winter)
The hot season (summer)

steps.confusionAlert: This is not a new question. It is a second, separate answer to the same question from Step 18. You only need one of the two answers.

phrases.english: Or, it is not difficult: that one is in the rainy season,
phrases.notes: Cold weather keeps the leftover meat from spoiling, so it still has value.

phrases.english: and here it is in the hot season.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְלָא קַשְׁיָא: הָהִיא – בִּימוֹת הַגְּשָׁמִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a second answer to the same challenge that Step 19 answered.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The two משניות contradict each other about whether נותר is worth a פרוטה.
steps.terutzMaskana: In winter נותר keeps its value. In summer it spoils and is not worth a פרוטה.
steps.whatToRemember: Whether נותר brings an אשם ודאי depends on whether the piece is worth a פרוטה. That can depend on its size or on the season.

steps.title: Quoting the next case in the משנה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the next line of the משנה: one person ate the first piece, and another ate the second.
steps.simpleTranslation: "If one person ate the first piece, etc."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up a new discussion. It quotes the משנה's case of two people who each ate one of the two pieces: plain חלב and חלב that is also נותר. There, רבי שמעון rules that each brings a חטאת, plus one more חטאת for the נותר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון's ruling gives an extra חטאת for נותר. That means the איסור of נותר took effect on a piece that was already forbidden as חלב. This is what רבא is about to question.

keyTerms.meaning: Short for "etc.": the rest of the משנה's line, which is not quoted here

phrases.english: "If one person ate the first piece, etc."
phrases.notes: This is the case of a piece of חלב and a piece of חלב that is also נותר, with two different people eating them.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָכַל אֶחָד אֶת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the פרוטה discussion to a new line of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: In the משנה, רבי שמעון says each eater brings a חטאת for חלב, and together they bring an extra חטאת for נותר.

steps.title: Does רבי שמעון hold that one איסור can fall on another?
steps.stepSummary: רבא asks how רבי שמעון can let נותר take effect on חלב, when a ברייתא shows he holds that a second איסור does not take effect on something already forbidden.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said to רב נחמן: Does רבי שמעון really say that one איסור takes effect on another? But a ברייתא teaches that רבי שמעון says: someone who eats נבלה on יום הכיפורים is exempt!
steps.whatsHappening: רבא challenges רבי שמעון's ruling in the משנה. He points to a ברייתא where רבי שמעון says the איסור of eating on יום הכיפורים does not take effect on נבלה, which was already forbidden.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the ברייתא, רבי שמעון holds איסור חל על איסור does not work: once food is forbidden, a second איסור cannot be added to it. In our משנה he seems to let נותר be added on top of חלב. These two rulings seem to clash.

keyTerms.meaning: A second prohibition taking effect on something that is already forbidden
An animal that died without proper שחיטה
Exempt, does not have to bring a קרבן

steps.whyThisMatters: The question of איסור חל על איסור comes up all over ש״ס. Here it is the key to explaining רבי שמעון's extra חטאת.

phrases.english: רבא said to רב נחמן:
And does רבי שמעון really say
that an איסור takes effect on an איסור?
phrases.notes: Here the איסור of נותר would be taking effect on a piece that was already forbidden as חלב.

phrases.english: But a ברייתא teaches that רבי שמעון says:
One who eats נבלה on יום הכיפורים is exempt!
phrases.notes: He is exempt from a חטאת for eating on יום הכיפורים, because the נבלה was already forbidden.

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמִי אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אִיסּוּר חָל אִיסּוּר? וְהָא תַּנְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the ruling of רבי שמעון quoted in Step 21.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי שמעון's ruling in the משנה that an extra חטאת is brought for נותר
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי שמעון holds elsewhere that a second איסור cannot take effect on food that is already forbidden. So נותר should not take effect on חלב.

steps.title: The case is a kidney with its fat
steps.stepSummary: רב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי answers that the משנה's case is someone who ate a kidney together with its fat.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב ששת the son of רב אידי said: The case is where he ate a kidney with its fat.
steps.whatsHappening: רב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי explains the משנה so that it does not need איסור חל על איסור. The piece was a kidney with its fat.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The kidney itself is not חלב. So the איסור of נותר can take effect on the kidney, because nothing was forbidding it before. That way רבי שמעון does not contradict his own view.

keyTerms.meaning: A kidney together with its fat

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי:
phrases.english: רב ששת the son of רב אידי said:
For example, where he ate a kidney with its fat.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי: כְּגוֹן דַּאֲכַל כּוּלְיָא בְּחֶלְבָּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבא's challenge in Step 22 by redefining the case in the משנה.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The נותר piece was plain חלב, so נותר would have to take effect on top of חלב.
steps.terutzMaskana: The piece includes the kidney, which is not חלב, so נותר can take effect on it.

steps.title: But the kidney is already forbidden as an altar part
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא objects: a kidney with its fat is already forbidden because it goes up on the מזבח. So how can the איסור of נותר take effect on it?
steps.simpleTranslation: But a kidney with its fat too already has the איסור of things that go up on the מזבח on it. How can the איסור of נותר come and take effect on it?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רב ששת's answer. Even the kidney already carries an איסור, because it is one of the parts that are burned on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב ששת's answer only works if the kidney started out with no איסור. But the kidneys of a קרבן are among the parts burned on the מזבח, so they are forbidden to eat. That puts us right back at איסור חל על איסור, which רבי שמעון does not accept.

keyTerms.meaning: The איסור on the parts of a קרבן that are burned on the מזבח (they "go up")
Takes effect on it

phrases.english: But a kidney with its fat too,
the איסור of things that go up on the מזבח already stands on it,
phrases.notes: The kidneys are among the קרבן parts burned on the מזבח, so nobody may eat them.

phrases.english: so how can the איסור of נותר come
and take effect on it?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכוּלְיָא בְּחֶלְבָּהּ נָמֵי, הָא קָאֵי עֲלַהּ בְּאִיסּוּר עוֹלִין
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רב ששת's answer from Step 23.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב ששת's claim that the kidney had no earlier איסור
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The kidney is already forbidden as a part that goes on the מזבח. So נותר would still be an איסור taking effect on an איסור, which רבי שמעון rejects.

steps.title: Maybe a severe איסור can take effect on a light one
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests that רבי שמעון lets נותר take effect because נותר is a severe איסור, and the איסור of 'things that go up on the מזבח' is light.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you would say that רבי שמעון holds that נותר is a severe איסור, so it can take effect on the light איסור of things that go up on the מזבח...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא offers a possible answer to the question from step 24. It is setting this answer up so it can test it in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The idea is that רבי שמעון's rule (a second איסור cannot take effect) might only apply when the second איסור is equal or lighter. Since נותר is severe and the איסור on מזבח parts is light, maybe the stronger one can take effect on top of the weaker one.

keyTerms.meaning: Meat of a קרבן left over past the time it may be eaten
A severe prohibition
A lighter prohibition
Parts that go up and are burned on the מזבח

phrases.english: And if you would say:
Rabbi Shimon holds
that notar is a severe prohibition,
and so it takes effect on the light prohibition of things that go up,
phrases.notes: 'Things that go up' means the parts burned on the מזבח, like the kidney with its fat from step 24.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי תֵימָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a possible answer to the קשיא in step 24.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Distinguishing by severity: a severe איסור can take effect on a light one
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי שמעון never lets a second איסור take effect on something already forbidden.
steps.terutzMaskana: Maybe he only blocks it when the second איסור is not more severe than the first.

steps.title: Rejected from נבלה on יום הכיפורים
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא rejects the severity idea. The איסור of eating on יום הכיפורים is severe and נבלה is light, yet רבי שמעון does not let the יום הכיפורים איסור take effect on נבלה.
steps.simpleTranslation: But נבלה is a light איסור, and יום הכיפורים is a severe איסור, and still the severe איסור of יום הכיפורים does not come and take effect on the light איסור of נבלה!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא knocks down the answer from step 25 by pointing to a case where a severe איסור does not take effect on a light one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If severity were the reason, then eating on יום הכיפורים, which is severe, should take effect on נבלה, which is light. Since רבי שמעון does not allow that, severity cannot explain why נותר takes effect.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal that died without proper שחיטה
The fast day, when eating is a severe איסור
But look, here is a case that shows otherwise

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix the two cases up: in this case the light איסור (נבלה) was there first, so the question is whether the later, severe איסור of יום הכיפורים can be added on top.

phrases.english: But an animal carcass, which is a light prohibition,
phrases.notes: This is the case of the ברייתא from step 22: eating נבלה on יום הכיפורים.

phrases.english: and Yom Kippur, which is a severe prohibition,

phrases.aramaic: וְלָא קָאָתֵי אִיסּוּר יוֹם כִּיפּוּרִים דְּחָמוּר
phrases.english: and the prohibition of Yom Kippur, which is severe, does not come
and take effect on the carcass, which is light!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא נְבֵלָה, דְּאִיסּוּר קַל הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the severity-based answer of step 25.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole idea that severity lets a second איסור take effect for רבי שמעון
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: In the case of נבלה on יום הכיפורים, a severe איסור does not take effect on a light one, so severity is not the deciding factor.

steps.title: קדשים are a special case
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that with קדשים, the תורה revealed that one איסור can take effect on another. That is why נותר can take effect on the kidney with its fat.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, with קדשים the תורה revealed that an איסור can take effect on another איסור.
steps.whatsHappening: After rejecting the severity idea, the גמרא gives a new answer: קרבנות have their own special rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון's general rule still holds: normally a second איסור cannot take effect. But for קדשים the תורה showed an exception, so נותר can take effect even on parts already forbidden because they go up on the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather; introduces a new answer after the old one fell
Holy things, meaning קרבנות
The Merciful One (the תורה) revealed
One prohibition takes effect on top of another

steps.whatToRemember: For רבי שמעון, a second איסור usually cannot take effect on something already forbidden, even if it is more severe. קדשים are an exception, because the תורה revealed that there it can.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up קדשים as an exception to the general rule of אין איסור חל על איסור, instead of changing the rule itself.

phrases.english: Rather:
with regard to sacrificial food, the Merciful One revealed
that a prohibition comes and takes effect on another prohibition,

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא: בְּקָדָשִׁים גַּלִּי רַחֲמָנָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a new answer to step 24's question after step 26 rejected the severity answer.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Special rule from the תורה for קדשים
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Severity is what lets נותר take effect on the מזבח parts.
steps.terutzMaskana: It is not severity; for קדשים the תורה revealed that one איסור can take effect on another.
